concept: clearing critical eligibility for impacts without amounts

compilers.behavior: left Eligible -> crit draw + Critical result

concept: exclusive-group composition across active and passive terms

compilers.behavior: winner selected over active cohorts AND passive terms
passives applied unconditionally; winner only over actives

evidence: Passive raw-163 activation compiles exclusive group 0 unconditionally (program/critical_damage_modifier.rs:341-349), so the asymmetric raw-163 loop cannot observe a passive group member: harmless redundancy (REJ-C-002).

concept: which impacts consult attack-table modifiers (hit / crit / defense)

compilers.behavior: damage-bearing impacts only; aura-only impacts keep baseline miss roll without modifiers

evidence: Hit-chance damage-only scope is documented (aura_subtype.rs:416, 476: 'non-damaging ... aura-only impacts remain unchanged'); Trinity applies hit modifiers to all hostile spells (Unit.cpp:12454-12488) - documented core_choice, not recorded as a finding. The crit inconsistency is recorded as CSA-C-01.

concept: selected-trait owner-policy check in final compilers of the Martial Expert package
evidence: The raw-638 member skips the owner-policy check but cannot compile without its op-15 sibling being declared (critical_block_amount.rs:287-295) and the sibling compiler rejects the same owner spell 429638; masked by the sibling today. Latent only if a future package admits raw 638 without a policy-checking sibling (UNK-C-003).

concept: critical multiplier baseline source for spell impacts vs white swings

compilers.behavior: actor baseline multiplier x raw 163 x op-15

evidence: White admission requires critical_strikes empty and isolated modifier programs (topology.rs:1099-1125, white_swing.rs:376-440) so no configuration combines a non-2.0 multiplier or raw 163 with white swings (REJ-C-003).
